typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @DAY as Numeric (10), @MONTH_RUN as Numeric (10) SET @DAY = DATEPART (DD,GETDATE ()) SET @MONTH_RUN = 15   SELECT  	 CM.[MemberID],  	 CM.[FacilityCode],  	 CM.[FirstName], 	 CM.[MiddleInitialName],  	 CM.[LastName],      [MemberStatus]= (CASE WHEN @DAY = @MONTH_RUN AND CM.MemberStatus = \'ACTIVE\' THEN \'ADD\' ELSE CM.[MemberStatus]  END),      CM.[Address],  	 CM.[City],  	 CM.[State],  	 CM.[zip],  	 CM.[DOB],  	 CM.[Sex], 	 CM.[ELIG_DT], 	 CM.[MAX_ELIG_END_DT], 	 CI3_SCORE = COALESCE(CAST(REPLACE(CM.CI3_SCORE, \',\', \'\') AS VARCHAR(25)),\'Not Available\'), 	 LIPA_SCORE = COALESCE(CAST(REPLACE(CM.LIPA_SCORE, \',\', \'\') AS VARCHAR(25)),\'Not Available\'),       PCP_TAX_ID = COALESCE(CAST(REPLACE(CM.PCP_TAX_ID, \'_\', \' \') AS VARCHAR(25)),\'Not Available\'), 	 PCP_NPI = (CASE WHEN CM.PCP_NPI_Nbr IN (\'\',\'.\',\'X\')  OR CM.PCP_NPI_Nbr IS NULL Then \'Not Available\'  ELSE CM.PCP_NPI_Nbr END), 	 PCP_PROV_NAME = (CASE WHEN CM.PCP_PROV_NAME IN (\'\',\'.\',\'X\',\'Not_Available\')  OR CM.PCP_PROV_NAME IS NULL Then \'Not Available\'  ELSE CM.PCP_PROV_NAME END), 	 PCP_STREET_ADDRESS = (CASE WHEN CM.PCP_STREET_ADDRESS IN (\'\',\'.\',\'X\')  OR CM.PCP_STREET_ADDRESS IS NULL Then \'Not Available\'  ELSE CM.PCP_STREET_ADDRESS END),  	 PCP_City = (CASE WHEN CM.PCP_City IN (\'\',\'.\',\'X\')  OR CM.PCP_City IS NULL Then \'Not Available\'  ELSE CM.PCP_City END), 	 PCP_STATE =(CASE WHEN CM.PCP_STATE IN (\'\',\'.\',\'X\')  OR CM.PCP_STATE IS NULL Then \'Not Available\'  ELSE CM.PCP_STATE END), 	 PCP_ZIP  = (CASE WHEN CM.PCP_ZIP IN (\'\',\'.\',\'X\')  OR CM.PCP_ZIP IS NULL Then \'Not Available\' ELSE LEFT(CM.PCP_ZIP, 5) END), 	CAREPROGRAM =(CASE WHEN CM.CAREPROGRAM IN (\'\',\'.\',\'X\')  OR CM.CAREPROGRAM IS NULL Then \'Not Available\'  ELSE CM.CAREPROGRAM END),   	CAREPROGRAM_Start_DT = REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), CM.CAREPROGRAM_Start_DT, 110),\'-\', \'/\') , 	CAREPROGRAM_END_DT =  REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), CM.CAREPROGRAM_END_DT, 110),\'-\', \'/\'), 	CAREPROGRAM_MGR_NAME = (CASE WHEN CM.CAREPROGRAM_MGR_NAME IN (\'\',\'.\',\'X\')  OR CM.CAREPROGRAM_MGR_NAME IS NULL Then \'Not Available\'  ELSE CM.CAREPROGRAM_MGR_NAME END), 	CAREPROGRAM_EMAIL_ADDRESS = (CASE When CM.CAREPROGRAM_EMAIL_ADDRESS = \'X\' THEN \'Not Available\' 	                                ELSE   CM.CAREPROGRAM_EMAIL_ADDRESS END), 	CAREPROGRAM_MGR_PHONE_NBR = (CASE When CM.CAREPROGRAM_MGR_PHONE_NBR = \'X\' THEN \'Not Available\' 	                                ELSE   CM.CAREPROGRAM_MGR_PHONE_NBR END) FROM	[DATA_EXCHANGE].[Crisp].[CrispMembers] CM JOIN	##Final_RR_Members RR ON		CM.MemberID = LTRIM(RTRIM(RR.[Member ID])) WHERE	RR.GRGR_CK = 5 AND		( 		             ( @DAY != @MONTH_RUN		AND MemberStatus != \'ACTIVE\' ) OR	           ( @DAY = @MONTH_RUN		AND 1=1 )									)',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Address as string,
		PCP_PROV_NAME as string,
		CareProgram_Email_Address as string,
		PCP_State as string,
		Sex as string,
		CI3_SCORE as string,
		FacilityCode as string,
		LIPA_SCORE as string,
		CareProgram_End_Dt as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CareProgram as string,
		DOB as string,
		PCP_NPI_Nbr as string,
		zip as string,
		PCP_Zip as string,
		FirstName as string,
		City as string,
		PCP_TAX_ID as string,
		CareProgram_Start_Dt as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PCP_City as string,
		MemberID as string,
		MiddleInitialName as string,
		State as string,
		CareProgram_Mgr_Name as string,
		LastName as string,
		MemberStatus as string,
		PCP_Street_Address as string,
		CareProgram_Mgr_Phone_Nbr as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Address,
		PCP_PROV_NAME,
		CareProgram_Email_Address = CAREPROGRAM_EMAIL_ADDRESS,
		PCP_State = PCP_STATE,
		Sex,
		CI3_SCORE,
		FacilityCode,
		LIPA_SCORE,
		CareProgram_End_Dt = CAREPROGRAM_END_DT,
		CareProgram = CAREPROGRAM,
		DOB,
		PCP_NPI_Nbr = PCP_NPI,
		zip,
		PCP_Zip = PCP_ZIP,
		FirstName,
		City,
		PCP_TAX_ID,
		CareProgram_Start_Dt = CAREPROGRAM_Start_DT,
		PCP_City,
		MemberID,
		MiddleInitialName,
		State,
		CareProgram_Mgr_Name = CAREPROGRAM_MGR_NAME,
		LastName,
		MemberStatus,
		PCP_Street_Address = PCP_STREET_ADDRESS,
		CareProgram_Mgr_Phone_Nbr = CAREPROGRAM_MGR_PHONE_NBR)) ~> FlatFileDestination
